howItWorks.title: Local collaboration, simplified.
howItWorks.subtitle: No servers to configure. No accounts to create. Just connect and go.

step1.title: 1. Enable Local Workspace
step1.description: The Host enters a workspace, opens Settings, and toggles on 'Local Workspace'. The app instantly broadcasts to your network.

step2.title: 2. Auto-Discovery & Join
step2.description: Teammates select 'Join' on their app. FlowDesk automatically finds active workspaces on the network. Just enter your name and click Join.

step3.title: 3. Host Approval
step3.description: The Host receives a join request and can accept or reject it. Once approved, the teammate enters and collaborates in real-time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the local-first approach.

questions.a: Yes. FlowDesk is completely free to use without any hidden subscription fees. You own your data forever.

questions.q: Do I need an internet connection to use it?
questions.a: For 'Private Workspace', you don't need any connection at all—it runs 100% offline. However, to use 'Local Workspace' with your team, you must be connected to the same local network (Wi-Fi or LAN).
It uses UDP broadcasting to discover peers on your local Wi-Fi, and SignalR for real-time syncing. As long as you are on the same router, it just works.

questions.q: What happens if the Host closes the app?
questions.a: If the Host disconnects, all connected members will be safely auto-kicked to the Welcome screen, ensuring no data corruption occurs.

questions.q: Will there be a cloud sync option later?
questions.a: Currently, FlowDesk is strictly local. However, our roadmap for v2.0 includes an optional self-hosted ASP.NET Core backend for those who want their own private server.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.body: Welcome to FlowDesk! Installation is straightforward. Simply download the `.exe` (for Windows) or `.dmg` (for macOS) from our Download page. Once installed, launch the application. You do not need an account or internet connection to start creating projects, tasks, and documents.

localWorkspace.title: Local Workspace Guide
localWorkspace.body: FlowDesk v1.5.0 introduces 'Local Workspace' – a magical way to collaborate without the cloud. To host a session, enter your workspace, go to Settings, and toggle 'Local Workspace' on. FlowDesk will use UDP broadcasting to advertise your session on your local network (Wi-Fi or LAN). For teammates to join, they just need to be on the same router, select 'Join' on their app, enter their name, and wait for your approval. All syncs happen in real-time via SignalR directly between your computers.

dataBackups.title: Data & Backups
dataBackups.body: Because FlowDesk is Local-First, your data never leaves your computer. Everything is stored locally in an SQLite database file. By default, FlowDesk automatically creates daily backups of your database to prevent data loss. You can find these backup files in your application data directory. We recommend occasionally copying these backups to an external hard drive or your own private cloud storage for extra safety.

philosophyPage.title: The Local-First Manifesto
philosophyPage.subtitle: Why we built a productivity tool that refuses to use the cloud.

content.heading: The SaaS Trap
content.body: Today's productivity landscape is dominated by Cloud Software-as-a-Service (SaaS). While convenient, it comes with a steep hidden cost: you don't own your data. When you put your life's work into a cloud app, you are renting access to your own thoughts. If the company goes bankrupt, changes its pricing, or gets hacked, you lose. We believe this is fundamentally broken.

content.heading: Data Sovereignty
content.body: FlowDesk was built on the principle of Data Sovereignty. 100% of your data lives on your local hard drive in an open SQLite database format. There is no telemetry, no forced cloud sync, and no tracking. Your private notes stay private.

content.heading: Speed and Reliability
content.body: Because there are no network requests to a server in Virginia, everything in FlowDesk happens instantly. There are no loading spinners when you switch projects. And best of all, you can do your best work on an airplane, in a cabin, or during an internet outage.

content.heading: Collaboration without Compromise
content.body: We believe you shouldn't have to sacrifice collaboration just to keep your data local. That's why we engineered our peer-to-peer Local Workspace technology. You can collaborate with your team in the same room, at the speed of your local Wi-Fi, without a single byte ever touching the public internet.
